title: The Latest Time to Catch a Bus
summary: Given a bus departure time array and a passenger arrival time array, both containing unique values, and a bus capacity limit, determine the latest arrival time to catch a bus.
statement: Given a bus departure time array and a passenger arrival time array, both containing unique values, and a bus capacity limit, determine the latest arrival time to catch a bus. Passengers board the first available bus if they arrive before or at the bus's departure time, and no more than the capacity limit is exceeded. If multiple passengers can board, the earliest arriving passengers do so. Ensure no two passengers board at the same time.
constraints: Buses and passengers arrive at distinct integer times; buses depart in increasing time order after boarding up to capacity waiting passengers.
Choose an arrival time not equal to any passenger time.
Return the latest time that lets you board some bus.
reference_solution:
def latest_bus_arrival(buses,passengers,capacity):
    buses.sort();passengers.sort();index=0;last_boarded=-1;seats=0
    for bus in buses:
        seats=0
        while index<len(passengers) and passengers[index]<=bus and seats<capacity:last_boarded=passengers[index];index+=1;seats+=1
    candidate=buses[-1] if seats<capacity else last_boarded-1
    occupied=set(passengers)
    while candidate in occupied:candidate-=1
    return candidate

hints: Simulate sorted buses boarding sorted waiting passengers.
After the final bus, start from its departure if it has a free seat; otherwise start one before its last boarded passenger.
Move backward while the candidate is an existing passenger time.
The simulation fixes the final capacity boundary, and every later time is either too late, displaced, or forbidden, proving maximality.
